about_short_description.short_description: MedMe Health is a patient care platform to help pharmacists schedule, conduct, and track clinical services.

product.name: MedMe Clinical Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered tool that transcribes pharmacist consultations in real time and automates clinical documentation.

product.name: MedMe Pharmacy Scheduling Software
product.description: A platform for pharmacies to schedule, manage, and track appointments for various clinical services including immunizations and minor ailments.

product.name: MedMe Minor Ailments Module
product.description: A module that guides pharmacists through clinical decision-making and prescribing for minor ailments, integrated with digital tools for workflow support.

product.name: MedMe Patient Relationship Management
product.description: Tools to enhance patient engagement through automated communications, secure messaging, and follow-up scheduling.

product.name: MedMe Reporting & Analytics
product.description: A suite of reporting tools providing operational insights, custom report building, and data export capabilities for pharmacies.
